Consumer candy for the builder:mise + verb:mise legs. It SELECTS the
out-of-tree external builder via `external_builder: mise`, so at image
build charly's build-path plugin connect + emitExternalBuilderStages seam
host-builds + connects candy/plugin-mise out-of-process, Invokes its
OpResolve, and splices the returned multi-stage block (pre-main-FROM) + the
COPY --from artifacts (post-main-FROM) into the generated Containerfile —
baking the mise binary, the shims, and /etc/mise/config.toml into the
image. The `mise:` verb step then installs node@22 (mise use writes
/mise.toml, installs, reshims), and the runtime checks prove both legs.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `run` | install node via the mise verb (mise use writes /mise.toml, installs, reshims) |
| `check` | the mise binary provisioned by the builder stage is on PATH |
| `check` | node installed by the mise verb resolves via the shims |
